Vendored dependency -- self-hosted per spec/architecture.md, Supply chain
(no third-party CDN sits inside the trust boundary).

Package:  zxcvbn, the password strength estimator behind the registration
          and change-password score bar.
Version:  4.4.2
Source:   npm pack zxcvbn@4.4.2, dist/zxcvbn.js verbatim
SRI:      sha384-LXuP8lknSGBOLVn4fwVOl+rWR+zOEtZx6CF9ZLaN6gKBgLByU4D79VWWjV4/gefq

It is the largest file the browser loads, most of it the frequency
lists, which is why only the screens that score a password pull it
in and the app shell does not (architecture.md, Supply chain). It is a
UMD bundle setting window.zxcvbn, and it uses neither eval nor Function,
so it runs under the CSP unchanged.

Re-pin by re-downloading dist/zxcvbn.js, recomputing:
  openssl dgst -sha384 -binary zxcvbn.js | openssl base64 -A
and updating this file, ZXCVBN_SRI in solvent/crypto.py and the copy of
it in static/js/strength.js.
